answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 133 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the tundra log shows the live set and the ridge audit records each lapse. Keeping 84 aliases alive therefore means 84 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the vault quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 17 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
